general-keymaps.title: Keymap & Keyboard Shortcuts
general-keymaps.description: Choose a familiar preset or customize Stage0 commands and navigation.

general-settings.title: General Settings
general-settings.description: Configure inline annotations, startup behavior, Explorer integration, and the terminal command.

appearance-theme.title: Theme & Interface Mode
appearance-theme.description: Choose whether to use the selected light or dark theme or follow your OS appearance.

appearance-language.title: Language & Localization
appearance-language.description: Choose the application language, date and time formats, and AI reviewer output language.

appearance-ui-font.description: Choose the font used for menus, navigation, labels, and buttons.

appearance-markdown-font.title: Markdown Font & Typography
appearance-markdown-font.description: Configure fonts for the Markdown editor, rendered preview, and code blocks, plus preview size and heading weight.

editor-diff.title: Diff Viewer & Code Navigation
editor-diff.description: Configure split/unified diff visualization, whitespace sensitivity, and inline blame.

ai-overview.title: AI

ai-mcp.title: MCP Servers

ai-external-agents.title: External Agents
ai-external-agents.description: Find, add, sign in to, and remove agents through the Agent Client Protocol.

ai-reviewers.title: Reviewer Bots
ai-reviewers.description: Configure reviewer roles and supplemental instructions for code reviews.

ai-sandbox.title: Sandbox & Tool Permissions
ai-sandbox.description: Review and change the elevated virtual sandbox permissions (In-Memory, Docker, Host).

ai-guardrails.title: Security & Guardrails
ai-guardrails.description: Path restrictions, destructive command blocking, and approval thresholds.

git-binary.title: Git Executable
git-binary.description: Select the Git executable used for repository operations. Saved Git credentials are not currently injected into Git commands.

git-credentials.description: Manage Stage0 credentials and mappings discovered from system/global Git helpers.

notifications-settings.title: Notifications & Push Alerts
notifications-settings.description: Configure native operating system notifications and event channels.

language.description: Choose the language used by Stage0 and its date and time formats.
